---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect behavior, a regression, or a suspected defect.
---

## Summary

<!-- Describe one problem and its impact. Identify suspicions as suspicions. -->

## Reproduction or evidence

<!--
Give the smallest known reproduction: input, relevant state/configuration,
command or API calls, and observed result. Include a short diagnostic excerpt
only when it helps explain the problem. Full logs, captures and evidence
archives are not required; do not upload them unless specifically requested.
For a performance discrepancy, give the reproduction command and conflicting
result so the software, tooling or documented assumptions can be investigated.
For an inspection-only finding, cite the revision, file and item inspected,
and say that runtime reproduction has not been performed.
A complete reproduction or a proposed fix is not required to report a concern.
Do not include private user dictionaries, personal input history, or secrets.
-->

## Expected and actual behavior

<!--
Explain the expected result and what actually happened. Keep a hypothesized
failure separate from an observed result. For a compatibility claim, link the
pinned-source analysis or existing evidence when available; otherwise say what
is still unknown. Do not present preferred behavior as established pin behavior.
-->

## Environment

<!--
Include the version or commit and relevant OS/architecture. Add the backend,
facade, build options, or tool versions only when relevant. State "Unknown"
for unavailable details; do not guess or imply untested platforms are affected.
-->

## Related work

<!-- Link related issues, PRs, or findings. Write "None" if there are none. -->
